Term1: Osteomyelitis with gram negative bacilli (other than pseudomonas)
Text:
# OSTEOMYELITIS WITH GRAM NEGATIVE BACILLI (OTHER THAN PSEUDOMONAS)

---

References:

- Sanford keyword: Osteomyelitis
- Mandell chapter: Osteomyelitis
- Lew DP Lancet 2004, 364: 369
- Cunha BA Clin Infect Dis 2002, 35: 287
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment

Ceftriaxone 1 gm IV q24h ($) [M] < OR > >
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h ($$) [R] < OR >
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h ($) [R]

## Outpatient

### Treatment

Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R] < OR >
Levofloxacin 500 mg PO qday ($) [R,DI]
